::: {#exr-twice-calls}
#### A function that calls itself twice

This Racket function computes the double-minus-one sequence of @exm-doubling-sequence,
but it finds $2 a_{n-1}$ as $a_{n-1} + a_{n-1}$, with two recursive calls:

```racket
(define (dm n)
  (if (= n 0)
      2
      (- (+ (dm (- n 1)) (dm (- n 1))) 1)))
```

Write down every call of `dm` that running `(dm 2)` involves, counting `(dm 2)` itself, and the value that each call returns.

:::
